## class Caligrafy\Scheduler

```php
namespace Caligrafy;

class Scheduler
```

Source: [framework/core/Scheduler.php:22](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Scheduler.php#L22)

Class Scheduler
An app declares its jobs in application/config/schedule.php: each one calls one capability with fixed inputs on a
fixed rhythm (every: 1m...1d, or a five-field cron in a timezone). The framework validates the file, runs the jobs
locally (php caligrafer.php schedule due / work) and prints the listing Caligrafy Cloud runs in production
(schedule list --json, version 1).

A run: one at a time per job (a database lock), in a child process stopped at its timeout, with full access like the
command line (Context::system: actor type schedule, actor id the job's name), recorded in caligrafy_job_runs (kept 30
days). Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 the capability failed or timed out, 2 the schedule file is invalid, 3 skipped.

### Constants

+ `FILE = 'application/config/schedule.php'`
+ `TABLE = 'caligrafy_job_runs'`
+ `LISTING_VERSION = 1`
+ `EVERY = ...`
+ `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 55`
+ `MAX_TIMEOUT = 300`
+ `KEEP_DAYS = 30`
+ `FIELDS = array('name', 'capability', 'input', 'every', 'cron', 'timezone', 'timeout', 'enabled')`
+ `OK = 0`
+ `FAILED = 1`
+ `INVALID = 2`
+ `SKIPPED = 3`

<a name="queue"></a>
## class Caligrafy\Queue

```php
namespace Caligrafy;

class Queue
```

Source: [framework/core/Queue.php:26](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Queue.php#L26)

Class Queue (2.18.0)

```
Queue::push('send_welcome_email', ['user_id' => $id]);                       // as soon as a worker is free
Queue::push('build_report', ['month' => '2026-11'], ['delay' => 600, 'attempts' => 5, 'timeout' => 120]);
```

A job is a capability and its input, kept in the caligrafy_jobs table (php caligrafer.php platform install, or the
deploy step, creates it). A worker runs each one in its own process, stopped at its timeout, with full access, as a
scheduled job (Context::system('queue', '&lt;capability&gt; #&lt;id&gt;')): check who may ask for the work before pushing it.

Workers: php caligrafer.php queue work (a loop, on your computer or your own server), or the scheduler: a job of
application/config/schedule.php on the framework's capability queue_work, every minute, which Caligrafy Cloud runs
too. A failed run is tried again after 30 s, 1 min, 2 min... until its attempts are used; an input the capability
refuses (invalid, not found) fails at once. Jobs are kept 7 days after they finish.

### Constants

+ `TABLE = 'caligrafy_jobs'`
+ `DEFAULT_ATTEMPTS = 3`
+ `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 60`
+ `MAX_TIMEOUT = 900`
+ `RETRY_SECONDS = 30`
+ `KEEP_DAYS = 7`
+ `NAME = '/^[a-z0-9_-]{1,40}$/'`

### Methods

+ [`Queue::push()`](#queue-push)

+ [`Queue::jobs()`](#queue-jobs)
